role: entry_audit independent narrow pre-code ABI review

finding.problem: Fixed three-argument fcntl PInvoke does not express native variadic third parameter under Apple ARM64 stack calling convention.
finding.requiredCorrection: Remove fcntl entirely; open stable existing private-root inode with O_RDONLY|platform O_CLOEXEC and its two fixed parameters only; flock/close unchanged.

preconditions: Darwin O_CLOEXEC=0x01000000 for UNITY_IOS&&!UNITY_EDITOR or actual runtime OSPlatform.OSX; Linux/Android supported ABI O_CLOEXEC=1<<19.
No O_CREAT or O_TMPFILE and therefore no optional mode argument; no file or directory creation through this open.
Unknown non-supported Unix platform must fail closed instead of assuming its flag ABI or falling back to fcntl.
Preserve Windows branch and all prior originals; bind changed FS bytes to new actual Linux FFI/interprocess/timeout and static Apple/Android compilation.
No Apple/APFS/iOS runtime proof inferred from constants, compilation or Linux/Windows evidence.

sources.supports: Apple ARM64 fixed versus variadic argument placement differs; fetched via indexed official page because JS/Markdown fetch was unavailable.
Apple ARM64 variadic arguments assigned to stack slots; fixed arguments follow their own calling rules.
O_RDONLY0, O_CLOEXEC0x01000000, open(const char*,int,...), fcntl(int,int,...), flock(int,int).
O_RDONLY0, O_CLOEXEC1<<19 in supported asm-generic Linux ABI.
Bionic imports Linux fcntl headers and open fixed path/flags plus optional variadic mode.

limits: Read-only design review only; no patch, compile, Unity, Git or CI action by reviewer. Earlier narrow a6bb closure remains historically bound and is not a guarantee of Apple ABI safety.
